description: Test .gitignore or glob patterns against a list of paths and see which rule matched each one. Operations: "test" — Match paths against gitignore rules (negation, anchoring, **, directory-only) or plain globs.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: Paths to test, one per line; end a directory with / (e.g. build/ or src/app.js).

operation.description: test — Match paths against gitignore rules (negation, anchoring, **, directory-only) or plain globs.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

mode.description: gitignore: git’s rules (last match wins, excluded parents stay excluded); glob: each pattern against the whole path, with {a,b}. Used by: test.

patterns.description: The patterns, one per line, as in a .gitignore file. Used by: test. Required by: test.

name: glob-tester
title: Glob & .gitignore Tester
